summary: Banner Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its merger with Pacific Financial Corporation, effective September 1, 2026. Under the Merger Agreement dated April 30, 2026, each Pacific Financial share converted into 0.2633 Banner shares, with Banner issuing about 2,654,563 shares. Bank of the Pacific also merged into Banner Bank, with Denise Portmann becoming EVP. No price per share or premium was disclosed. The transaction represents a completed stock-for-stock acquisition; risk-arb angle is moot post-closing, but integration execution and share issuance effects warrant monitoring.
